Lazard (2024). Levelized Cost of Energy+ (LCOE v17.0, LCOS v9.0, LCOH v4.0). Lazard, June 2024. No DOI.

48-page slide report. Locators are printed page numbers (equal to PDF pages). Heat-relevant rows only: geothermal, gas peaking, new-build nuclear (large LWR), gas combined cycle (LCOE appendix pp.36, 38) and the Green and Pink hydrogen PEM/alkaline electrolyzer cases (LCOH key assumptions p.47), plus the hydrogen storage costs on pp.28-29 (new vs 2023). No CCS section in the 2024 edition (it is in 2023 only). Skipped: solar, wind, coal, storage LCOS, hybrids, marginal costs. Ranges are low case to high case with no central value, so value is blank. OVERLAP: all LCOE rows and the four electrolyzer cases repeat Lazard 2023 (lazard_2023_001); this edition supersedes the 2023 values. Traps: (1) price year not stated, 2024 used; (2) 2024 LCOH figures INCLUDE underground hydrogen storage (USD 20/kg, 120 t green / 200 t pink) unlike v2/v3, so they are not comparable with 2021/2023 production-only LCOH; (3) pink hydrogen uses marginal operating costs of an existing, fully depreciated nuclear plant at 95% capacity factor; (4) Key Assumptions list tax rate 40% and WACC 9.1% but the p.46 sample calculation shows 21% and a 58% efficiency from v3.0; (5) "Capacity 100 - 20 MW" gives the low-case (100 MW) to high-case (20 MW) range, so capex and LCOH ranges mix scale with case; (6) subsidized LCOH assumes the 45V credit and excludes Energy Community adders; (7) nuclear and geothermal values are earlier editions adjusted for inflation.
